architecture: Local width/budget adaptation of BlinkDL RWKV-v8 RWKV7+ROSA parallel hybrid. 96D main, 32 independent binary ROSA streams, original 64x8 KS2 decoders and 2048D side/history. Matched version reduces decay/rate/value ranks to16 and gate rank to40. Full version retains original ranks32/32/32/64.

provenance.architecture: RWKV-7 recurrence plus parallel 1-bit QKV ROSA, each with its own LayerNorm on the same 96D main input. Add both updates before the unchanged KS2 decoder. History stores the combined post-attention state.
provenance.rosa: 32 binary Q/K/V streams, 96-to-32 biased projections, three 96D time-mix vectors, 32 learned payload scales, biased 32-to-96 output. Longest matching Q suffix in strictly previous K; latest endpoint wins; read successor V. No match and matched zero both map to negative payload, matching the pinned hybrid.
provenance.backward: Exact single-bit counterfactual Q/K/V credits across the full 64-token window, multiplied by sigmoid(logit)*(1-sigmoid(logit)), tau=1. This is a specified discrete surrogate, not the analytic derivative of hard thresholds. GPU implementation verified against brute force.
provenance.initialization: Original decoder/embedding/head weights paired. Reduced controllers keep the leading columns/rows of original factors. ROSA QKV use PyTorch Linear initialization, payload scales one, time mix zero, output weight/bias zero to preserve initial logits.
provenance.unchanged: All four 64-rank8 KS2 decoders, 2048D side residual and both historical main states per previous layer. No Hadamard replacements in RWKV or ROSA. Same 15k-step FP32 data/optimizer schedule.
provenance.implementation: Short-window GPU bit-packed exact suffix comparisons and full single-bit flip enumeration; not an asymptotically optimized long-context ROSA automaton.
provenance.qualification: A local width/budget adaptation of the official hybrid demonstration with an explicitly supplied trainable backward, not an official pretrained RWKV-8 model.

validation: ROSA hard forward matches pinned official suffix-automaton reference, GPU exact bit-flip credits agree with brute force, GPU graph capture passes. Paired unchanged model parameters, matched initial logits, finite training/nonzero ROSA QKV gradients, causality, source hashes, data, optimizer counters and checkpoint reevaluation checked.
limits: One training seed per configuration. The official hybrid demo has no ROSA backward; this experiment uses an explicitly documented discrete counterfactual surrogate with Bernoulli credit mapping. This is an adaptation, not an official full-scale RWKV-8 training recipe. Sequence length64 and state resets match earlier runs; results do not measure long-context benefits.
